sources.title: Visa Burkina: electronic visa service
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate-General of National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: The live portal identifies its Ministry of Security / National Police copyright and directly links the applicant subdomain. It describes a general electronic workflow, not nationality eligibility.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les postulants peuvent obtenir leur visa par voie électronique.

sources.title: Visa Burkina applicant configuration endpoint
sources.officialityEvidence: The public Ministry-linked applicant frontend uses this endpoint for visa types, nationalities and restrictions. Direct anonymous GET replay returned HTTP 401 over normally validated TLS, without a configuration payload.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Full authentication is required to access this resource.

sources.title: Communiqué following United States visa restrictions
sources.publisher: Government Information Service of Burkina Faso
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government Information Service communiqué records the United States visa-restriction issue, but publishes no operational ordinary-passport visitor route, effective implementation, duration or exception schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Communiqué suite à la restriction des visas des Etats-Unis d’Amérique.
